provenance: Project HERCULES | owner Joseph Balmaceda | HRC-JB-0924-O7
declaration: RULES.md DECL-P4-15 item a (P4-M-OUT), tiling and display as DECL-P4-2 item 2
eligible_rule: valid_fraction >= 0.5 (canvas mask = grid mask nearest-neighbour x20; beyond canvas = invalid)
display: raw uint8 prediction, 0 outside mesh-valid, builder.area_downscale (cv2.INTER_AREA) to 1068 x 1068, builder.png_bytes (IHDR/IDAT/IEND only); 1068/T display px per canvas px = 53.40 px/mm
stats_definition: mean, std, frac_ge_150 over raw canvas pixels inside mesh-valid, before downscale

tile_points.content: float32 (n,3) x,y,z in 20260411134726 voxels; seeded subsample [20260926,r,c], <= 4096

geometry.labelled_adjacent_rule: min distance < 1.2 mm to any valid vertex of the 8 labelled 2.4um meshes

direction.CONFLICT: The declared per-tile rule gives a weak +0.127 (outward = increasing column); the same-angle crossing check gives outward = DECREASING column in 93 % of 2731 pairs (column 0 = outer end, as on the w010-027 strips). Per-tile radius over 2 windings is dominated by the scroll's out-of-roundness. The orchestrator must decide which rule fixes the outward end before candidates are formed.

blank_tiles_all_zero_prediction.note: published prediction is exactly 0 over the whole mesh-valid area of these tiles (not computed or zero-filled); they are blank, not evidence of no ink; they count as blank for the DECL-P4-15(a) gate
